title: Marimba
creator: 3D Vault
notes: The project-owner source link matches the source ID embedded in the original GLB. The public API confirms 3D Vault and CC BY 4.0; human publication review remains pending.

provenance.sourceIdentification: Source link supplied by the project owner; metadata checked using the public Sketchfab model API.

modifications: Optimized embedded textures with image deduplication and non-color maps capped at 512 px, retaining color maps up to 1024 px. Reduced near-planar geometry using a 3-degree Blender dissolve threshold with normal, material, seam and UV boundaries protected; retained the model silhouette in reviewed views. Further joined the six generic mesh chunks, welded coincident vertices and applied a 0.4 collapse reduction; final model has 114,001 triangles and one material draw.
